flow: Job import -> EU fit check -> Save EU fit result -> application kit -> waitlist / feedback

notes: No real CV text is used.
No real job descriptions are used.
No real email, phone, visa, payment, cookie, token, API key, or secret is used.

tests.testName: homepage loads and shows the main CTA
tests.expectedResult: Homepage shows AutoTime AI private beta copy and primary CTA.
tests.notes: Verifies first screen and beta positioning.

tests.testName: job import accepts valid fake job data
tests.expectedResult: Valid fake job populates fields and enables Save EU fit result.
tests.notes: Uses fake company and fake job URL only.

tests.testName: empty job import blocks progress with disabled save action
tests.expectedResult: Save EU fit result remains disabled when job details are empty.

tests.testName: EU fit cannot run before job import
tests.expectedResult: Check EU fit is disabled before job import.

tests.testName: EU fit result is visible after job import
tests.expectedResult: Evidence-led role decision appears with confidence text and save action enabled.

tests.testName: application kit generates after EU fit is saved
tests.expectedResult: Application kit generation shows Profile summary and no job guarantee wording.
tests.notes: Verifies Save EU fit result persists tracked job.

tests.testName: waitlist and feedback actions are simple and safe
tests.expectedResult: Waitlist and feedback mailto links are visible and disclaimer text appears.
tests.notes: Does not submit real user data.

tests.testName: full private beta flow completes without visible crash
tests.routeOrTarget: Job import -> EU fit -> tracked job -> application kit -> feedback
tests.expectedResult: Full flow completes and no visible application/runtime crash appears.
tests.notes: Core Private Beta v1 browser journey.

tests.testName: sentry test page is unavailable in production smoke targets
tests.expectedResult: Sentry test page is hidden on production smoke targets and visible in local dev.
